fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 1: ChristianaCare appoints 12 residents to the categorical internal medicine program each year. Additionally, ChristianaCare appoints 4 internal Medicine/Pediatrics and 3 Internal Medicine/Emergency Medicine interns each year.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 2: ChristianaCare has been a top-rated academic medical center for more than a century. Residents and fellows experience a rigorous and rewarding combination of academic training and hands-on experience. The Internal Medicine Residency Program attracts candidates from around the country who value our challenging university-affiliated academic curriculum within a community-based setting.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 3: The ChristianaCare Internal Medicine Residency was the first program in the country to develop an innovative 4+2 ambulatory block schedule. Each resident’s schedule thus consists of a four-week inpatient-medicine experiences alternating with a two-week ambulatory-medicine experiences.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 4: The inpatient-medicine experiences will consist of general inpatient medicine at Christiana Hospital and Wilmington Hospital, as well as rotations in the MICU and CICU. Additionally, the inpatient based specialty rotations will occur during the 4 week blocks of time (e.g. cardiology, pulmonary, nephrology, hematology, infectious diseases and neurology).
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 5: Comprehensive Clinical Training: The program provides extensive training with rotations in various subspecialties, ensuring residents gain broad clinical experience in inpatient, outpatient, and emergency settings.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 6: High Patient Volume: ChristianaCare ranks highly for admissions, providing residents with exposure to a wide range of pathologies and medical conditions, enhancing diagnostic and treatment skills.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 7: Innovative Curriculum: Features advanced simulation training, regular educational conferences, and hands-on procedural experience, preparing residents for modern internal medicine practice.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 8: Dedicated Faculty: Faculty members are nationally recognized and committed to mentorship, education, and the professional development of residents.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 9: Research Opportunities: Encourages active participation in research projects, with opportunities to present at national conferences and publish findings, promoting a strong academic environment.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 10: State-of-the-Art Facilities: ChristianaCare boasts modern training facilities, including high-fidelity simulation labs, ensuring residents have access to the latest medical technologies.
